summary: Frontend-only verification of the duplicate-trend warning box in Empresa → Tendencias cards. All three test cases passed: (1) MSFT (no covering thesis) shows the warning with msg 'Puedes añadir...', a working <a> link to /thesis/thesis_test_aidc, and the 'Añadir' button. (2) NVDA (already in thesis_test_aidc) shows the warning with trend-already-in text, the same link, and NO 'Añadir' button. (3) In both cases the warning has the required RED styling (background rgb(251,228,224) = #FBE4E0, border rgb(179,42,34) = #B32A22). The findMatch substring fallback is working — backend returned trend_name 'Inteligencia artificial y centros de datos' (exact) and the slug 'inteligencia art-0' matched correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: ThesisResult.jsx is now ~520+ lines; recommend splitting TrendCard (and its dup-warning logic) into its own file for maintainability.

Two <Link> elements with the same data-testid `trend-dup-link-${slug}` are rendered in conditional branches inside TrendCard (lines 334 & 340); only one renders at a time so it's fine functionally, but consider unifying to avoid duplicate-testid risk if both branches ever rendered together.
